result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.contract_nodes_multi()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Contract multiple nodes into a single node. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12224-L12299){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.contract_nodes_multi(nodes, self_loops=True) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Merges all specified nodes into the first node in the list. All edges incident to any of the contracted nodes are redirected to the first node. Edges between contracted nodes become self-loops (if `self_loops=True`). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs or labels to contract. The first node is the target; all other nodes are merged into it. [self_loops]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True` (default), edges between contracted nodes become self-loops. If `False`, such edges are removed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new graph with all specified nodes contracted into one. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any node does not exist. [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the node list is empty. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - time complexity: `O(k * E)` where `k` is number of nodes to contract - the first node in the list retains its ID and attributes - all other nodes are removed from the graph ## Examples {.doc-examples} Contract a community into a single node: ::: {#e7f98839 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph(directed=False) g.add_path_graph(6) # 1 -- 2 -- 3 -- 4 -- 5 -- 6 # Contract nodes 2, 3, 4 into node 2 result = g.contract_nodes_multi([2, 3, 4]) # Returns 4 (nodes 1, 2, 5, 6 - nodes 3,4 merged into 2) result.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 4 ``` ::: ::: Contract detected communities: ::: {#b2e73c68 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} g = ec.Graph(directed=False) g.add_path_graph(10) # Build a simple graph # Detect communities (use return_dict=True to get dict) membership = g.cmty_louvain(return_dict=True) # Get nodes in community 0 community_0 = [n for n, c in membership.items() if c == 0] # Contract that community if len(community_0) > 1: simplified = g.contract_nodes_multi(community_0) ``` :::
